title: Warmly Spiced Mediterranean Pumpkin Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful pilaf featuring roasted pumpkin, mixed with aromatic spices and high-protein ingredients, perfect for a satisfying meal. This dish is designed to be meal-prep friendly, with a focus on fatty and snappy textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roast the pumpkin in the oven for 30 minutes, or until tender.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the quinoa and chicken broth to the skillet, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the quinoa is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the quinoa mixture with a fork, and stir in the roasted pumpkin.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
